title: Slow Cooker Brown Sugar BBQ Chicken Leg Quarters
cook: 5–6 hr on low, plus 10 min under the broiler

items: 4 chicken leg quarters (about 3 lb total), fully thawed
1 large yellow onion, halved and sliced

steps: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. If 4 whole quarters won't fit in your slow cooker in one snug layer, cut each one through the joint between the thigh and drumstick.

In a small bowl, mix the brown sugar, smoked paprika, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, dry mustard and cayenne until no sugar clumps remain. Rub it over every side of the chicken, working some under the thigh skin.

Spread the onion in the slow cooker and add the vinegar and Worcestershire sauce. Set the chicken on top skin side up, overlapping as little as possible. Add no other liquid; the chicken and onion release about 1 cup.
Cover and cook on low 5–6 hr, until the thickest thigh reads at least 175°F and the meat pulls easily from the bone.
Heat the broiler with a rack about 6 inches from the heat. Line a rimmed sheet pan with foil. Move the chicken onto it skin side up with a wide spatula and tongs, since it will be very tender.

Whisk the barbecue sauce and honey together. Brush half over the chicken and broil 3–4 min, until bubbling. Brush on the rest and broil 2–3 min more, until sticky and charred at the edges. Watch closely, since the sugar burns fast.
Skim the fat off the cooking liquid and serve the onions alongside the chicken.
tips: Thighs and drumsticks bought separately work the same way. Use about 3 lb.
If the sauce starts to burn, move the rack lower and broil in 1–2 min bursts.
Leftover meat pulled off the bone works in the Barbecue Chicken Pizza in place of the grilled breast.
storage: Fridge up to 4 days. Freezer up to 3 months. Reheat in a 350°F oven 15–20 min, until it reaches 165°F.
